audience: developers and sysadmins who run cloud servers on UpCloud

useCases.title: Check which servers are running or stopped
useCases.text: The AI lists servers with state, zone, plan, cores and memory, filtered by state, search text, tags or labels, and opens one for its IPs and storage.

useCases.title: Review last month's bill by resource
useCases.text: The AI reads the billing summary of one month with amount, hours, plan and zone per resource, and the price list for comparison.

useCases.title: Check firewall rules, IP addresses and networks
useCases.text: The AI lists the firewall rules of a server in order, the IP addresses on the account and the networks with their subnets.

useCases.title: Find who changed a resource
useCases.text: The AI reads the audit log: who did what to which resource, when and from which IP. It filters by action, resource type, time window or keyword.

useCases.title: Start, stop or restart a server
useCases.text: The AI starts a stopped server, or stops or restarts a running one, softly or hard. Stop and restart take it offline, so confirm first.

useCases.title: Back up a disk or set a server's backup schedule
useCases.text: The AI takes an on-demand backup of a storage device and follows its state. It can also change a server's simple-backup schedule.
